ROOT_CAUSE:
The tap point for the gatherable tabs was read off the frame on every step and then thrown away.

Every failure on the deployed revision was this one skill: four SELECT_RESOURCE steps, refused in 0.11-0.14 s with no after-frame at all. Their own before-states carry the contradiction:

    resource_search_open  = True
    resource_target       = MEAT
    resource_tab_kinds    = ('BEAST', 'GIANT_BEAST', 'MEAT', 'WOOD')   <- the wanted tab is drawn
    resource_tab_offset   = None
    anchored_tab_kind     = None
    resource_selected_tab = None

The identity layer knows the wanted tab is on screen -- it read its printed label -- while the geometry layer resolves nothing, so `RESOURCE_DYNAMIC`'s single line, `resource_cell_center_norm(resource)`, answers nothing and the executor refuses before any tap. An identity with no point.

`ocr.read_resource_tab_labels` returns exactly what is missing: `kind -> that tab's centre`, read from the client's own printed label at 0.95-1.00 confidence. Two of the five tabs have used it as their tap point since 2026-09-21 -- `BEAST_SEARCH_TAB` returns `frame.resource_beast_tab_norm`, `GIANT_BEAST_SEARCH_TAB` returns `resource_giant_beast_tab_norm`, and the latter's comment states that the label box is the fallback for a frame whose strip could not be located at all. The observation kept those two centres and discarded the gatherable ones, holding only their names in `resource_tab_kinds`. So the defect is not a missing mechanism: it is the project's own chosen pattern, applied to the two tabs it needed first and never wired to the ones it needs next.

NEXT_RECOMMENDATION: WB-1002-19-DISPATCH-AFTER-PROOF (P0) next: it is the one open order whose absence can turn 'nothing happened' into a pass, and it is the mirror of what was fixed two rounds ago.

Then WB-1002-21-STRIP-BRACKET-CHAIN-DEAD: measure the geometry branch on >=10 frames before touching a threshold, because a dead branch that carries a brain gate is worth more than the tap point it also failed to provide.

Worth a policy answer rather than a fix: three of the last four rounds have found a reading that existed, was correct, and had no consumer. The checks that catch it are cheap (does the producer's value reach a click or a verdict?) and are not yet part of the standing routine.
recommended_codex_review: One judgement worth yours: this fix makes a dispatch that was previously impossible now possible, in a skill that is 0-for-25 today. The supporting evidence is strong -- the regression was a discarded read, not a missing capability, the four archived frames each resolve to a point that lands on the wanted tab when drawn, and the live run selected MEAT and verified it -- but it is still a behaviour change in the direction of doing more, and I would rather you knew that explicitly than read it as bookkeeping.

Second: the pattern has inverted. Rounds 15 to 18 were all 'the reader was lying'; this one is 'the reader was right and nobody listened'. If the standing routine should gain one check, it is not another guard -- it is asking, for every value the observation computes, who consumes it and what would have to be true for nobody to notice.
